git_commit.message: security: Fix 6 HIGH findings - URL injection and API key protection

summary:
All 6 HIGH security findings have been fixed using Swift-idiomatic patterns:
- 3 URL injection vulnerabilities in AssemblyAITranscriptionService (SEC-001)
- 3 URL injection vulnerabilities in AssemblyAIBackend (SEC-004, SEC-005, SEC-006)
- 1 URL injection/path traversal protection in MLXModelDownloader (SEC-003, already fixed)
- SecureString type provides API key protection with ~Copyable and memory zeroing
